description: Mark one or many emails as read. Accepts a single UID or an array — pass an array to flag N messages in one IMAP STORE round-trip (useful when triaging).

accountId.description: Account ID (from imap_list_accounts). Optional if accountName is given or only one account is configured.

accountName.description: Account name instead of accountId. Optional if accountId is given or only one account is configured.

uid.description: Email UID, or array of UIDs to mark as read in one call (avoids N round-trips when triaging). All listed UIDs share the same IMAP STORE command, so the operation is atomic at the server level.

name: imap_mark_as_read
